name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.camera.video_selfie.video_selfie_checks.VideoSelfieChecksActivity
description: Before video recording, this screen lists the checks the user must complete, such as showing an ID, looking at the camera, and speaking a prompt. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from seeing and completing the required video-selfie instructions.
